class.name: NNSTParallel
class.brief_description: A state that runs all of its eligible child states concurrently as parallel regions.
class.description: Use when an entity needs multiple independent state machines active at the same time (for example, lower-body movement states running alongside upper-body weapon or animation states). When entered, every enabled direct child state whose [method NNSTTickedNodes.on_enter_condition] returns [code]true[/code] becomes active at once. Events and ticks are delivered to every active region independently; direct transitions between sibling regions are not allowed.
